text_block_list.text:
The three years I spent running alongside 
Air Groove have finally come to an end—

In the Twinkle Series, she achieved 
results truly worthy of the title 
"Empress."

And from here on out— a brand-new 
challenge begins.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san! Could you tell us about 
your plans moving forward!?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Is there any possibility of an overseas 
campaign? Are there any notable rivals 
from the new generation you have your eye 
on...?!

text_block_list.name: Practicing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waah, it's Air Groove-senpai! Cool as 
always~~!

text_block_list.name: Practicing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"She's totally surrounded by the media 
again today. The 'Empress' really is 
something else..."

When I headed out to the track to look for 
Air Groove, she was surrounded by 
reporters and spectating Umamusume.

I suddenly remember something from a while 
back. Air Groove seemed busy at the time, 
so I held back from speaking to her.

Back then, she had noticed me as well. And 
later, she was angry at herself for not 
speaking up.

Those memories feel strangely nostalgic. 
Lost in that sentiment—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ......Excuse me. My Trainer has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Let's go.

Air Groove takes my hand and pulls me 
along as she walks...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, all these recent interviews 
are unbearable. Even getting some solo 
practice in takes quite an effort.
choice_data_list:
Did we really have to go all the way back 
just for that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is the place with the least 
interference. It cannot be helped.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...More importantly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What was that just now, you? Did you 
think that passed for a greeting?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Project your voice properly with more 
volume. Otherwise, you'll be drowned out 
by the crowd."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly— Puff out your chest more. Hold 
your head high."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because you are... my trainer, after all.
